title: Charred Sevaiiya Noodle Salad
description: A flavorful and refreshing salad made with charred Sevaiiya noodles, mixed with vibrant Peruvian ingredients.

ingredients.name: Charred red onion
ingredients.notes: charred in a pan with some oil

instructions: Cook the Sevaiiya noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Char the red onion in a pan with some oil until it's caramelized.
Dice the bell peppers and chop the cilantro.
Seed and chop the aji amarillo peppers.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, charred red onion, bell peppers, cilantro, and aji amarillo peppers.
In a small bowl, mix together the lime juice and olive oil.
Pour the dressing over the noodle mixture and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
